stalledQueue.scenario: fetch never resolves; four retry callbacks plus online event
stalledQueue.interpretation: No app deadline: later flushes cannot retry or send subsequent sets until browser fetch settles. Data remains durable.

cameraRace.scenario: getUserMedia resolves after sheet close and module cleanup
cameraRace.interpretation: Late stream is started after teardown and no remaining cleanup owns it; camera can remain active until another page lifecycle event.

navigationRace.interpretation: Earlier slow GET overwrites later chosen page; there is no request generation guard in go(). DOM is stubbed; browser corroboration remains useful.

precache.interpretation: Decoded filesystem bytes, not compressed network transfer; current worker fetches the entire list on each changed cache version.
